title: Q-FLEETMAP-seed: ultrastable/seed is not equal to its source (13 file(s) differ, 2 missing, 4 only in the copy)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** fleetmap --drift --apply (daily in tenant-sync.yml)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe seed
**Prediction:** fleet_map_drifted_repos <= 0 within 168 h
**Status:** open

ultrastable/seed is a copy and is not equal to its source (FLEET-MAP-1): 13 file(s) differ, 2 missing, 4 only in the copy.

- differ: .github/workflows/funding-maintenance.yml, .github/workflows/memory-fresh.yml, .github/workflows/org-profile-probe.yml, .github/workflows/outreach.yml, README.md, SYSTEM.md, agents/AGENTS.md, bootstrap/bootstrap.py, docs/claims.json, doctrine/constitution.json, doctrine/schemas/catalog.json, scripts/system.py ...
- missing: doctrine/schemas/humanvoice.schema.json, doctrine/schemas/verification.schema.json
- extra: doctrine/balance.json, doctrine/system.json, worker/src/stepplan.js, worker/test/stepplan.test.js

Fix the sync named in doctrine/fleet-map.json for this repository (never copy by hand), then the same reading closes this item.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe seed
